Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill. Cooks very evenly with no areas hotter than the others.  Sears wonderfully!
Results.Title: Spirit E-325 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.! Solid and even heat. Love the sear feature.
Results.Title: 3 burner

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for choosing a Weber grill! We are very sorry to learn about the squeaky lid, and we are here to help! Our grills carry an excellent limited warranty.

It is possible that the lid was skewed to one side when it was installed. This can be easily resolved by unclipping the lid hardware and recentering the lid.

Your satisfaction is important to us. Please look for an email outreach from our Specialist team soon!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The grill was fine but the lid is making a lot of noise when opening and closing.  I'm afraid to use it.
Results.Title: Grill lid faulty

Results.ReviewText: This is the 3rd Weber that I have owned, and like the first two, it is exactly what was advertised and perfect for my needs.
Results.Title: Functional and practical

Results.ReviewText: The grill is everything I thought it would be. It is perfect for the 2 of us.
Results.Title: Spirit E-325

Results.ReviewText: It’s a very nice grill and cooks great. I wish it started as easy as they say it should. Have had a few fire balls when trying to start and not sure how to avoid this.  I have begun to start the grill with a long lighter to avoid the fire balls.
Results.Title: 3 burner grill

Results.ReviewText: great grill and awesome quality. very good food gets made by it
Results.Title: grill rocks

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill for what I needed. Like the searing function and the design of the bottom shell. My last grill, not a Weber, would flare up occasionally and burn the food. This grill is designed to not allow that. We'll done.
Results.Title: Excellent design

Results.ReviewText: Third one I’ve owned and love it. We have moved several times and purchase this same grill at our new location.
Results.Title: Perfect size for us!

Results.ReviewText: One of the best Webers albeit not the most expensive. Works great gets hot quickly. I have yet to use the search feature. I've not found it necessary. Great product.
Results.Title: One of the best

Results.ReviewText: Great grill…easy to operate, heats fast and evenly, and cooks with that nice grilled flavor. Highly recommended!
Results.Title: Total Public

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill.  It's the perfect size heats up to high temperatures quickly.  the metal grilling grate is thick which keeps the contact of food to metal very hot, the metal used for the lid also has a good thickness to it which I believe will last a long time.  Drip pan is very easy to assess and the design of the liquid/fat run off to the drip pan is very well thought out, so it drain into the pan.  More than I can say for some other grills I have had.  I would highly recommend this grill
Results.Title: The perfect BBQ grill

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber Gas Grill.  Have owned a Weber charcoal kettle for decades. Our previous gas grills were lesser quality but larger. I am hopeful that the Weber lasts longer! The smaller size is perfect for a couple (2).
Results.Title: Right size for 2

Results.ReviewText: I did not notice that there was no back panel when I was shopping.  Luckily I have a cover that keeps animals, dirt, leaves etc from taking roost. Seems like a very cheap thing to do especially you pay for a Weber and expect a class product.
Results.Title: No back cover comes with this unit.

Results.ReviewText: Have only used once, to grill steaks. Best ever on a gas grill. High temperature on sear section really worked.
Results.Title: Great sear

Results.ReviewText: I never saw the need to spend more money on a Weber Grill. So I usually buy the cheaper on sale grills at the Box stores.. They are good for a short while. But my kids talked me into springing for a Weber.. WOW! They were right! I love this grill. It cooks evenly and I am very, very pleased! A guy can learn something from the kids!
Results.Title: Excellent Grill!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the cost of the Spirit E-325 gas grill. We will be sure to bring your comments to our team for consideration. If you need any further assistance, please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Nice little grill, but way over priced. 500usd is pretty ridiculous. Should be about 180, giving Weber plenty left over. .
Results.Title: Expensive little grill.

Results.ReviewText: My wife & I decided to donate our dated SS 4 burner gas grill and downsize to a Weber 3 burner. We were able to reach the 600*F temp within a timely manner thus minimizing the cook times for pizza pies. We are happy with the purchase!
Results.Title: Grilling Pizza Pies

Results.ReviewText: Had a charcoal Weber grill which I loved, but decided to switch back to propane for the first time in years. This Spirit grill is excellent!
Results.Title: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane).

Results.ReviewText: I've been purchasing Weber grills for the last 20 years because of their quality. This was the smallest grill that I've purchased and it's good. My one issue is that weber doesn't very often have sales, and I also miss their yearly factory sale.
Results.Title: It's good.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the best I have ever owned. Natural gas burns cleaner than propane and I don't have to haul the bottles anymore.  Very few flareups is great as well.
Results.Title: The Best!

Results.ReviewText: I like 3 burners.  Definitely gets hot enough.  I DO NOT like the wheels.  It doesn't move easily and is heavy with a full tank of gas
Results.Title: Always a Weber

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month ago for an apartment balcony. I had a 4 burner genesis before with side burner. This 3 burner works just fine. Of course not as hot as the genesis.The two burners with burst setting make up for searing etc.
Results.Title: Great size and features

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are very sad to hear about your experience and will be sure to share this with our team. Please look for our follow up email soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: My grill was performing beautifully - until it wasn't!
Results.Title: From great to awful

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes a great grill. This is my second gas grill, downsizing from my Genesis. This grill doesn’t disappoint and will last me another 20 years.
Results.Title: Awesome products

Results.ReviewText: Previous Weber Spirit lasted 12 years and I used it on average 1-1.5 times per week. Worked perfectly even up till I upgraded to my new Weber which I absolutely LOVE! The only thing wrong with my previous Spirit is the wheel broke off due to rust. Actually I'm happy I got 12 years out of it considering I do live in South Florida with the rain/high humidity and I keep mine outside under pool cage with only a Weber cover over it....any other grill may have lasted 5-6 years. I've used new Weber grill 5 times so far and I give it 5/5 👍👍👍👍👍!
Results.Title: HONEST REVIEW

Results.ReviewText: I'm really liking this barbecue. It wasn't difficult to assemble, even with my wife yelling at me. The build quality is high, as I have come to expect from Weber grills.  The Spirit E-325 is for my rural cabin, where the weather conditions are harsh and the animals are big.  My Weber Silver at home in the city is still going strong after at least 15 years. If I can get half of that out of my Spirit, I'll be happy. Unfortunately, I tried another brand, and it only lasted for less than 3 years.
Results.Title: Pleased So Far

Results.ReviewText: It needs a griddle that fits. When I purchased this grill I was  mislead about a griddle I could buy after my initial purchase. I wasn’t in a hurry at the time I bought because the grill itself was pricey. I asked for add ons to this grill as Christmas gifts, to find out they have no griddle that’ll fit.
Results.Title: Griddle needed!!

Results.ReviewText: I don’t have money to spare with purchases of any kind, so I did plenty of research before deciding on this grill. Is it more expensive than its competitors? Yes, but the quality and performance more than justifies the premium price. The few Weber charcoal grills I’ve had over the years similarly outperformed their competitors, so I felt at ease buying this gas grill.
Results.Title: Absolutely worth the premium price. Get it!

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and are sorry to hear about the dent in the grill. Your satisfaction is invaluable to us, and we are here to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: We bought a Weber bbq for our son and his family for his birthday. It came dented and I called Ace hardware before the delivery guys drove away, and Ace wouldn’t exchange it or do anything for me. The manager told me that I needed to call Weber and work it out with them to get the parts replaced that were dented. And then we would have to fix it. This was so disappointing!
Results.Title: Dented bbq on arrival

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-325 gas Grill is just wonderful.  Easy to light, nice range of termperatures to cook almost anything - nice grills that are easy to clean - a little difficult to turn off the gas following cooking - too far back but manageable. Compact and just another great product from Weber.
Results.Title: Great things come in small packages

Results.ReviewText: This grill is excellent, the only drawback for me is the back is not covered and animals can get in
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I like the somewhat compact sized and ability to easily relocate it to my garage, since it was purchased for a second/seasonal home.  It did a great job with a variety of foods.
Results.Title: Heats quickly and evenly.
